sentence: This project tests whether ultra-high-field magnetic resonance imaging can measure small brain changes in the preclinical stage of Alzheimer's disease.
This project tests whether three proteins linked to rare neurological diseases can carry out chemical reactions, even though such proteins were thought to be inactive.
This project tests whether lower levels of a protein in cell fusion lead triple negative breast cancer cells to resist a drug.
This project studies how losing a cell cycle regulator changes zinc handling and makes melanoma resist treatment.
This project studies when and how bacteria use a contact-dependent weapon to attack neighbors and harvest nutrients in microbial communities.
This project uses mouse and human stem cell models to find what controls how islet cells take on and keep their identities.
This project studies how obstructive sleep apnea and HIV, alone and together, affect ventricular repolarization lability.
This project studies how excessive lipid metabolism weakens tumor-reactive T cells and causes immune suppression in tumors.
This project studies how the timing and dose of iron treatment affect brain mitochondrial function in rats with iron deficiency.
This project studies how peroxisomal metabolism of branched chain fatty acids switches on brown fat thermogenesis, a possible way to treat obesity.
This project tests whether machine learning can find signs of kidney obstruction in renal scans and kidney ultrasounds that human reviewers cannot see.
This project tries to find out which molecular factors and cellular structures keep adult muscle stem cells in quiescence.
This project studies how immune dysregulation arises and leads to autoimmunity and inflammation.
This project studies how plants control genome structure and development to limit the effects of mutations spreading through transposons.
This project uses the mosquito Aedes aegypti to study how fast, and how, ecological differences evolve in its genes.
This project studies cancer prevention, early detection and the delivery of cancer care in varied communities using observational, cohort and interventional studies.
This project uses machine learning with treatment, survey and genetic information to classify chronic conditions in adult survivors of childhood cancer.
This project tests whether several dimensions of sleep together predict cognitive decline and Alzheimer's disease markers, using machine learning to examine brain aging.
This project upgrades the hardware and software of a whole body 7 Tesla MRI scanner to support research on diseases.
This project builds an X-ray dual-energy cone-beam microCT tool that finds positive margins during breast conserving surgery to reduce re-surgery.
